title: How to Build a Survey Tool With AI (Typeform Alternative in Hours)
summary: Build your own survey tool with AI — conditional logic, NPS, response analytics, and custom branding. Skip the $79/mo Typeform bill. No code needed. → blink.new
body_markdown: Two reasons: response limits and data ownership. Typeform's Basic plan is $39/month for 100 responses — a single user study exhausts that in days. Their Business plan at $129/month covers 10,000 responses, but that is $1,548/year for a tool that still stores all your data on their servers. A custom build stores unlimited responses in your own database with no per-response pricing and no vendor lock-in.
